result.brief: 提出 GeoTex 占用世界模型：将列内高度模式与跨列关系编码为紧凑连续潜表征，并以固定关系记忆与残差更新实现历史锚定的 4D 占用预测。
result.reason: Proposes a 4D occupancy world model with a compact continuous latent encoder for 3D geometry and history-grounded forecasting, directly matching occupancy world modeling and latent representation learning.
